kings1.21.p1.b1.text: Some time later, Naboth the Jezreelite happened to own a vineyard in Jezreel next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

kings1.21.p1.b2.text: “Give me your vineyard to use as a vegetable garden… I will give you a better vineyard in its place—or if you prefer, I will give you its value in silver.”

kings1.21.p1.b3.text: “The LORD forbid that I should give you the inheritance of my fathers.”

kings1.21.p1.b4.text: So Ahab went to his palace, sullen and angry… He lay down on his bed, turned his face away, and refused to eat.

kings1.21.p2.b1.text: “Why are you so sullen that you refuse to eat?”

kings1.21.p2.b2.text: “…And he replied, ‘I will not give you my vineyard!’”

kings1.21.p2.b3.text: “Do you not reign over Israel? Get up, eat some food, and be cheerful, for I will get you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

kings1.21.p3.b1.text: Then Jezebel wrote letters in Ahab’s name, sealed them with his seal, and sent them to the elders and nobles who lived with Naboth in his city.

kings1.21.p3.b2.text: In the letters she wrote: “Proclaim a fast and give Naboth a seat of honor among the people. But seat two scoundrels opposite him…”

kings1.21.p3.b3.text: “Naboth has cursed both God and the king!”

kings1.21.p3.b4.text: So they took him outside the city and stoned him to death.

kings1.21.p3.b5.text: Then they sent word to Jezebel: “Naboth has been stoned to death.”

kings1.21.p4.b1.text: “Get up and take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, who refused to give it to you for silver. For Naboth is no longer alive, but dead.”

kings1.21.p4.b2.text: And when Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, he got up and went down to take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.

kings1.21.p5.b1.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying,

kings1.21.p5.b2.text: “Get up and go down to meet Ahab king of Israel, who is in Samaria. See, he is in the vineyard of Naboth, of which he has gone to take possession.

kings1.21.p5.b3.text: “This is what the LORD says: ‘Have you not murdered a man and seized his land?’”

kings1.21.p5.b4.text: “In the place where the dogs licked up the blood of Naboth, there also the dogs will lick up your blood—yes, yours!”

kings1.21.p6.b1.text: “So you have found me out, my enemy.”

kings1.21.p6.b2.text: “I have found you out because you have sold yourself to do evil in the sight of the LORD.”

kings1.21.p6.b3.text: “This is what the LORD says: ‘I will bring calamity on you and consume your descendants…’”

kings1.21.p6.b4.text: And the LORD also speaks concerning Jezebel: ‘The dogs will devour Jezebel by the wall of Jezreel.’

kings1.21.p7.b1.text: Surely there was never one like Ahab, who sold himself to do evil in the sight of the LORD, incited by his wife Jezebel…

kings1.21.p7.b2.text: When Ahab heard these words, he tore his clothes, put on sackcloth, and fasted.

kings1.21.p7.b3.text: He lay down in sackcloth and walked around meekly.

kings1.21.p8.b1.text: Then the word of the LORD came to Elijah the Tishbite, saying:

kings1.21.p8.b2.text: “Have you seen how Ahab has humbled himself before Me?”

kings1.21.p8.b3.text: “Because he has humbled himself before Me, I will not bring the calamity during his days…”

kings1.21.p8.b4.text: “…but I will bring it upon his house in the days of his son.”
